subtitle: A livelier agent list, Agent Memory in place of Tools, and a terminal pane beside the chat.

cards.title: An agent list that shows the work
cards.text: Each agent has its own character with a speech bubble for what it is doing, the allowance left on its account, and a width you can drag.

cards.title: Agent Memory replaces Tools
cards.text: The notes every agent shares, grouped by day and filtered by who wrote them. Traces groups by day too.

cards.title: A terminal beside the chat
cards.text: With the office hidden, the terminal opens in a pane beside the chat, and its edge can be dragged.

also: Queued messages show in the chat
No more freezes from the login shell
The tab strip names the open tab
